$comment: Target structure for a digitized college timetable. Design notes: (1) a class cell can span multiple periods (merged cell, e.g. OE-1 across periods 3-4) -> represented by 'periods': [3,4] on one slot object, not duplicated per period. (2) a cell can hold multiple stacked entries (different batches sharing a slot) -> 'entries' is always an array, length 1 in the common case. (3) recess/break columns are real slots with type='recess' and no entries, so the grid stays rectangular and renderable as a table. (4) legends (subject abbreviations, faculty initials, batch roll ranges) are separate lookup tables referenced by code, not inlined, so the same legend can be reused across terms.

properties.confidence: high | medium | low - OCR/extraction confidence for this whole document

monday.changed: bool, only present on revision documents, true if the source highlighted this cell as different from the prior version

notes: string - anything the extractor is unsure about, so a human can verify
